mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.goods_img AS goodsImg, g.goods_price AS goodsPrice, g.goods_name AS goodsName, g.goods_stock AS goodsStock, g.goods_detail AS goodsDetail, g.goods_title AS goodsTitle, tg.end_date AS endTime, tg.stock_count AS stockCount, tg.start_date AS startTime, tg.seckill_price AS seckillPrice FROM goods g LEFT JOIN t_seckill_goods tg ON g.id = tg.goods_id ORDER BY g.id

SELECT g.id, g.goods_img AS goodsImg, g.goods_price AS goodsPrice, g.goods_name AS goodsName, g.goods_stock AS goodsStock, g.goods_detail AS goodsDetail, g.goods_title AS goodsTitle, tg.end_date AS endTime, tg.stock_count AS stockCount, tg.start_date AS startTime, tg.seckill_price AS seckillPrice FROM goods g LEFT JOIN t_seckill_goods tg ON g.id = tg.goods_id WHERE g.id = #{goodsId}
